verdict.rationale: Kick's MCP server lets an agent "execute bookkeeping changes" and "update bookkeeping — all with your approval", and Kick runs a real double-entry ledger, so agent-driven ledger edits are plausible. However, nothing documents an agent drafting or posting manual journal entries. The "approval" described is the user confirming in the chat, not an accountant-facing review queue, and no public OpenAPI spec was found. Missing for 10: an explicit API/MCP tool for creating journal entries, a draft/pending state with an accountant review queue, a public REST API spec, and hands-on corroboration.
